scope: Maintainer review of direct M3 transcription diagnostics; no Document/OCR Harness adoption

claims: M3 defaults to adaptive thinking; thinking.type=disabled skips it.
reasoning_split separates output fields without disabling thinking.
max_tokens is deprecated in favor of max_completion_tokens; present experiment used observed accepted legacy cap.

limitations: Raw thinking never saved. Source transcription and final non-thinking response remain only under temporary probe directories.
Initial unsplit stop response had insufficient diagnostics to attribute its decode failure; do not retrospectively claim all failures were fences.
Character checks cover specific source passages, not complete OCR accuracy or CER.
Timing comes from a small run, not an isolated performance benchmark.

usable_transcriptions.recovery: single outer json fence removed locally
